parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

- If you do not set this parameter or you set it to a value less than 20, the default value is 20.
- If you set the value to greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NetTestType
parameters.description: The type of the network test.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the value of \`NextToken\` that is returned in the last response.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
